'''Zothique''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which served elegant and expensive dishes.<ref name="MedStar II" />

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]] liked to eat there before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
